summary: All eight documented export_scene.gltf keywords exist on Blender 5.2.1 LTS and the documented call produced two non-empty GLBs (676628 and 139768 bytes).

assumptions: Keyword presence was checked with bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf.get_rna_type().properties on Blender 5.2.1 LTS (111 operator properties), not by comparing exported geometry against the 4.5 documentation the claim was sourced from.
export_format is a dynamic enum on 5.2.1 and reports no static enum items, so the value GLB was verified only by the export succeeding and producing a readable GLB.

source_refs.locator: bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf() parameter list: export_format (str) "Format, Output format"; export_apply (bool) "Apply Modifiers, Apply modifiers (excluding Armatures) to mesh objects -WARNING: prevents exporting shape keys"; export_yup (bool) "+Y Up, Export using glTF convention, +Y up"; export_extras (bool) "Custom Properties, Export custom properties as glTF extras"; export_lights (bool) "Punctual Lights"; export_draco_mesh_compression_enable (bool) "Draco Mesh Compression, Compress mesh using Draco"; export_animation_mode (Literal 'ACTIONS', 'ACTIVE_ACTIONS', 'BROADCAST', 'NLA_TRACKS', 'SCENE') signature default 'ACTIONS'; export_force_sampling (bool) "Always Sample Animations"; filter_glob default '*.glb'

payload.remaining_uncertainty: Presence and defaults were observed; the behaviour of each keyword beyond export_apply, export_extras, export_lights and the Draco flag was not isolated by A/B export.
